integration_removed.description:
The TP-Link LTE integration has been removed from __HA_KEEP__.

The integration has not been working since __HA_KEEP__ 2023.6.0, has no maintainer, and its underlying library depends on a package with a [critical security vulnerability]({ghsa_url}).

To resolve this issue, remove the `tplink_lte` configuration from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart __HA_KEEP__.
integration_removed.title: The TP-Link LTE integration has been removed
